title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Programme, implemented by Trócaire in the Balaka, Chikwawa and Machinga districts of Malawi, contributes to outcome 3.1 Women and older adolescent girls experience increased safety, psychosocial wellbeing, and meaningful participation and leadership. The objective is to increase women and older adolescent girls’ voice and leadership in all spheres. Activities include training on women's participation in decision making processes; providing key supports to Women Centred Organisations, and advocating for their participation in national and international fora. The programme is in partnership with WOLREC, COWHLA, FOCESE, Gender and Justice Unit, and MIAA. Other partners may be included. ---- The principal focus of this outcome is:Women’s empowerment and participation in decision making spaces
